cards.ex: After that hike, I slept like a baby.
cards.exUz: O'sha yurishdan keyin, men chumolidek uxladim.
cards.uzDef: Juda tinch va chuqur uxlash, xuddi go'dak kabi.

cards.ex: His plan to become a famous actor is just a pipe dream.
cards.exUz: Uning mashhur aktyor bo'lish rejasi shunchaki amalga oshmas orzu.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi juda qiyin bo'lgan orzu yoki reja.

cards.ex: "Do you think I'll win the lottery?" "In your dreams!"
cards.exUz: "Meningcha, lotereyada g'alaba qozonamanmi?" "Tushingga kirsin!"
cards.uzDef: Bu hech qachon sodir bo'lmaydi degan ma'noda aytiladi.

cards.ex: Winning the competition was a dream come true.
cards.exUz: Musobaqada g'alaba qozonish - bu orzuning ushalishi edi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt xohlagan narsaning amalga oshishi.

cards.ex: Even though it's hard, he continues to dream the impossible dream.
cards.exUz: Qiyin bo'lishiga qaramay, u imkonsiz orzu qilishda davom etadi.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan maqsadga intilish.

cards.ex: I'm a night owl; I do my best work late at night.
cards.exUz: Men tungi qushman; eng yaxshi ishimni kechqurun qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha uxlashni xohlamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: I think I just need to sleep it off; I'll feel better in the morning.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, shunchaki uxlab tuzalishim kerak; ertalab o'zimni yaxshi his qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Uyqu orqali kasallik yoki muammoga yechim topish.

cards.ex: I'm going to have forty winks before we go out tonight.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun ko'chaga chiqishdan oldin qisqa muddatga uxlab olmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Kunduzi qisqa muddatga uxlab olish, dam olish uchun.

cards.ex: Don't lose sleep over things you can't control.
cards.exUz: Siz nazorat qila olmaydigan narsalar haqida xavotirlanmang.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qayg'urib, xavotirlanib uxlay olmaslik.

cards.ex: He must have woken up on the wrong side of the bed; he's been grumpy all day.
cards.exUz: U, albatta, ertalab yomon kayfiyatda uyg'ongan; u butun kun davomida jahldor bo'lib yuribdi.
cards.term: wake up on the wrong side of the bed
cards.uzDef: Ertalab yomon kayfiyatda uyg'onish, jahldor bo'lish.

cards.ex: As soon as his head hit the pillow, he was out like a light.
cards.exUz: Boshi yostiqqa tegishi bilan u darhol uxlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va qattiq uxlab qolish, darhol uxlab qolish.

cards.ex: "Do you think you'll win the lottery?" "In your dreams!"
cards.exUz: "Siz lotereyada yutib olasiz deb o'ylaysizmi?" "Hech qachon!"
cards.uzDef: Bu hech qachon sodir bo'lmaydi degan ma'noda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: I could feel myself drifting off to sleep as the movie played.
cards.exUz: Kino davom etayotganida uyquga ketayotganimni his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Asta-sekinlik bilan uyquga kirish jarayoni.

cards.ex: You look exhausted; you should get some rest.
cards.exUz: Siz juda charchaganga o'xshaysiz; siz dam olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish, kuch to'plish uchun uxlash yoki tinch o'tirish.

cards.ex: I hit the snooze button three times this morning.
cards.exUz: Men bugun ertalab budilnikni uch marta kechiktirdim.
cards.uzDef: Budilnikni o'chirish o'rniga kechiktirish tugmasini bosish.

cards.ex: I'm not sure what to do; I'll sleep on it and decide tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Men nima qilishni bilmayman; Men bu haqda o'ylab ko'raman va ertaga qaror qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Bir qaror qabul qilishdan oldin, bu haqda o'ylab ko'rish.

cards.ex: He was dead to the world and didn't hear the thunderstorm.
cards.exUz: U hech narsani sezmas darajada qattiq uxlab qoldi va momaqaldiroqni eshitmadi.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsani sezmaydigan darajada qattiq uxlab qolish.

cards.ex: Losing his job was a wake-up call for him to change his lifestyle.
cards.exUz: Ishdan ayrilishi uni turmush tarzini o'zgartirishga majbur qilgan ogohlantirish bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatning kutilmagan ta'siri, haqiqatni ko'rishga majbur qiladi.

cards.ex: I never thought I'd get this opportunity, not even in my wildest dreams.
cards.exUz: Men hech qachon bunday imkoniyatga ega bo'lishni o'ylamagan edim, hatto eng yaxshi orzularimda ham.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvur qila oladigan eng yaxshi narsalarimda ham.

cards.ex: I slept right through the thunderstorm last night; I didn't hear a thing.
cards.exUz: Men kecha momaqaldiroqni butunlay uxladim; hech narsa eshitmadim.
cards.uzDef: Shunday qattiq uxlab qolish, shovqin yoki hodisani sezmaslik.

cards.ex: She struggled with wakefulness due to the stress of her job.
cards.exUz: U ishning stressi tufayli uyg'oqlik bilan kurashdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt uxlashga qodir bo'lmaslik holati.

cards.ex: After a long day of hiking, I slept soundly.
cards.exUz: Uzoq kunlik sayohatdan so'ng, men tinch uxladim.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur va xotirjam uxlash.

cards.ex: I usually take a cat nap in the afternoon to recharge.
cards.exUz: Men odatda tushdan keyin quvvat olish uchun qisqa uyquga ketaman.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa, yengil uyqu.

cards.ex: It's getting late, I think I'll hit the sack.
cards.exUz: Kech bo'lyapti, menimcha men yotishga boraman.
cards.uzDef: Uxlash uchun to'shakka borish.

cards.ex: I always wake up groggy, no matter how much sleep I get.
cards.exUz: Men har doim uyqusirab uyg'onaman, qancha uxlasam ham.
cards.uzDef: Uyg'onganidan keyin chalkash yoki charchagan his qilish.

cards.ex: She spends a lot of time daydreaming about traveling the world.
cards.exUz: U ko'p vaqtini dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilish haqida xayol surish bilan o'tkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Real hayotdan chalg'ib, xayollarga berilish.

cards.ex: That horror movie was total nightmare fuel; I couldn't sleep for days.
cards.exUz: Bu qo'rqinchli film dahshatli tush edi; men bir necha kun uxlolmadim.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqinchli yoki bezovta qiluvchi narsa.

cards.ex: I had a vivid dream last night that felt so real.
cards.exUz: Men kecha juda real tuyulgan yorqin tush ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda aniq va batafsil tush.

cards.ex: Sleep paralysis is a frightening experience, but it's usually harmless.
cards.exUz: Uyqu falaji qo'rqinchli tajriba, lekin odatda zararsiz.
cards.uzDef: Uyg'onish yoki uxlash paytida harakatlana olmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm going to have a lie-in tomorrow; I'm so tired.
cards.exUz: Men ertaga kechgacha uxlayman; men juda charchadim.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan kechroq turish.
